name: navbar-masthead
title: Masthead navbar
description: An editorial header in three tiers: a thin date and account line, the publication name set large in the middle, and the sections ruled below.
docs: Pass name (a string or your wordmark; nameHref makes it a link home), date (today's, from the server), locale and timeZone, sections ({ label, href }), actions (sign in and a subscribe button) and currentHref. The three tiers are siblings and the header is display: contents, so the top line and the sections are sticky for the whole page: put the header directly in the page's wrapper, not in a wrapper of its own. The name scrolls away behind the top line; there is no scroll handler. The date is written with Intl in the stated locale and time zone, so server and browser agree. Below md the sections scroll sideways with the current one brought into view and the date shortens. sticky={false} makes it an ordinary header. linkAs renders the section links with your router's Link.
